issues.description: v3-beta default speaker disagrees between docs (aditya) and TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS (shubh)
issues.detail: Module docstring, class docstring, and PR description all declare aditya as the bulbul:v3-beta default, but TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS sets default_speaker='shubh'. Pick one source of truth and align docs, dataclass, and enum ordering. Silent doc/code drift on a user-visible default is a real regression risk.

issues.description: Incompatible-parameter warnings compare against pydantic defaults instead of detecting explicit user input
issues.detail: Checks like params.pitch != 0.0, params.loudness != 1.0, params.temperature != 0.6 conflate 'user passed default' with 'user passed nothing'. A v3 caller explicitly setting pitch=0.0 gets no warning; a v2 caller setting temperature=0.6 likewise. Use model_fields_set or an explicit None sentinel to detect intent.

issues.description: Pace silently clamped to per-model range, violating the InputParams Field contract
issues.detail: InputParams declares pace ge=0.3, le=3.0, then __init__ silently clamps to the per-model pace_range with only a warning. Two layers of preconditions disagree, and the constructor neither rejects invalid input nor exposes the tighter v3 range through types. Either raise ValueError (matching unsupported-model behavior) or push range into per-model Field constraints.

issues.description: voice_id never validated against TTSModelConfig.speakers despite the data being present
issues.detail: TTS_MODEL_CONFIGS carries a speakers tuple per model and SarvamTTSSpeakerV2/V3 enums exist, but __init__ accepts voice_id without checking membership. A v2 speaker sent to v3-beta fails server-side instead of raising a clear client-side ValueError. The infrastructure exists; wire the check at construction.

issues.description: STT _connect silently drops input_audio_codec from connect_kwargs with no justification
issues.detail: The previous payload included 'input_audio_codec': self._input_audio_codec; the refactored payload removes it without comment. If the SDK still consumes that key for v2.5 endpoints, this is a silent regression for existing saarika:v2.5 / saaras:v2.5 users. Document the rationale or restore the field.

issues.description: get_speakers_for_model silently falls back to v2 speakers for unknown models
issues.detail: The helper returns v2 speakers for any unrecognized model name with no signal, contradicting __init__'s strict ValueError on unknown models. A caller validating against a typo'd or future model gets a plausible-but-wrong answer. Raise ValueError or return an empty list so the contract is unambiguous.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the refactor to ModelConfig/TTSModelConfig dataclasses is the right direction: model capability becomes data instead of substring sniffing on model names. However, the implementation is under-finished in five concrete ways: the v3-beta default speaker disagrees between docs (aditya) and config (shubh); 'ignored parameter' warnings use float-equality against defaults instead of detecting explicit user input; pace is silently clamped rather than rejected, with two contradictory precondition layers; voice_id is never validated against the per-model speakers tuple the PR just introduced; and STT silently drops input_audio_codec from connect_kwargs with no explanation. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK — resolve the spec/code contradictions and pick one validation discipline (raise vs. silent-fix) before merge.
